config_toml:
# Cheers ACP connector config for bot "e2e-codex" (agent: codex).
# Generated by the Cheers onboarding flow.
#
# Before first start:
#   mkdir -p ~/.cheers/workspace ~/.cheers/secrets
#   # write the one-time bot token to the sidecar referenced below (chmod 600)
#   # then: cce-acp-connector start --config <this file> --name e2e-codex

version = 1

[daemon]
name       = "e2e-codex"
state_path = "state-e2e-codex.json"
log_dir    = "logs-e2e-codex"

# Optional: let the connector update itself when this server publishes a newer
# release (ed25519-signed manifest, sha256-verified binaries, auto-rollback).
# Kept commented out — executing downloaded code is the host owner's call, and
# connectors older than 0.1.27 reject configs containing this section.
# [update]
# auto = true

[accounts.e2e-codex.bridge]
control_url           = "ws://127.0.0.1:1/ws/agent-bridge/control"
data_url              = "ws://127.0.0.1:1/ws/agent-bridge/data"
host_credential_file = "secrets/e2e-codex.token"
heartbeat_interval_ms = 25000
ack_timeout_ms        = 600000

[accounts.e2e-codex.bridge.reconnect]
base_ms = 500
max_ms  = 30000

[accounts.e2e-codex.adapter]
type    = "stdio"
command = "codex-acp"
args    = []

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.sessions]
create             = true
load               = true
cancel             = true
terminate          = true
request_timeout_ms = 120000

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.prompt]
allow                 = true
max_concurrent        = 1
max_prompt_bytes      = 200000
max_duration_ms       = 900000
allow_attachments     = true
allow_images          = true
allow_local_file_refs = false

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.workspace]
default_cwd         = "~/.cheers/workspace"
allowed_roots       = ["~/.cheers/workspace"]
remote_terminal     = false
remote_open         = false
backend_may_set_cwd = true

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.env]
inherit = false
allow   = ["HOME", "PATH", "OPENAI_API_KEY", "CODEX_API_KEY"]
# Headless API-key auth: put ANTHROPIC_API_KEY / OPENAI_API_KEY in the *connector
# process* env (systemd EnvironmentFile / launchd EnvironmentVariables — install.sh
# does this when those vars are exported at install time). Shell-only export does
# not reach the keep-alive unit. Do not paste secrets into this TOML.

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.config]
backend_may_set_model = false
backend_may_set_native_options = false
allowed_config_options = ["model", "reasoning_effort", "approval_policy", "sandbox"]

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.permission]
forward_to_backend = true
wait_timeout_ms    = 900000
on_timeout         = "cancel"
# auto_allow = false routes each ACP tool-permission prompt to the channel so a
# human (owner / delegate) decides. Set true to approve locally and skip cards.
auto_allow         = false
# auto_allow_cheers_mcp = true auto-approves Cheers native MCP tools (post_message,
# get_channel_info, etc.) so standard bot channel actions run without redundant prompts.
auto_allow_cheers_mcp = true
# ── L0 set-mode envelope (host-sovereign; see BOT_CONFIG_GOVERNANCE.md) ──
# backend_may_set_mode: may the platform change the session permission mode at
#   runtime (L2 session/set_mode). allowed_modes: opaque ACP modeIds the platform
#   may select (empty = any mode the agent advertises in session/new). The connector
#   matches these by exact string — it has no notion of what a mode means.
backend_may_set_mode = true
allowed_modes        = []

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.send]
allow          = true
max_text_bytes = 200000
max_files      = 10

[accounts.e2e-codex.policy.mcp]
backend_may_inject_extra_servers = false
allowed_servers                  = ["cheers"]
